mapper.select: SELECT CATEGORY_CODE as categoryCode, NAME as categoryName, PARENTS_CATEGORY as parentCategoryCode FROM CATEGORY ORDER BY CATEGORY_CODE ASC

SELECT c.CLASS_CODE as classCode, c.OPERATOR_CODE as operatorCode, c.CATEGORY_CODE as categoryCode, c.NAME as name, c.PRICE as price, c.DESIRED_PRICE as desiredPrice, c.ADDRESS as address, c.STAR_RATING_AVG as starRatingAvg, (SELECT ci.IMAGE FROM CLASS_IMG ci WHERE ci.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE AND ROWNUM = 1) as mainImage FROM CLASS c
AND (c.CATEGORY_CODE = #{categoryCode} OR c.CATEGORY_CODE IN (SELECT CATEGORY_CODE FROM CATEGORY WHERE PARENTS_CATEGORY = #{categoryCode}))
AND c.CATEGORY_CODE = #{subCategoryCode}
AND c.PRICE >= #{minPrice}
AND c.PRICE <= #{maxPrice}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CLASS_REPEAT_RULE crr JOIN SCHEDULE s ON s.REPEAT_RULE_CODE = crr.REPEAT_RULE_CODE WHERE crr.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE
AND TO_CHAR(s.CLASS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = TO_CHAR(CAST(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) + (9/24) AS DATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND s.START_TIME > TO_CHAR(CAST(SYS_EXTRACT_UTC(SYSTIMESTAMP) + (11/24) AS DATE), 'HH24:MI') AND s.REMAINING_PEOPLE > 0 )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM class_repeat_rule crr JOIN SCHEDULE s ON s.repeat_rule_code = crr.repeat_rule_code WHERE crr.class_code = c.class_code
AND TO_CHAR(s.class_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') IN ( TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') + 5, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), /* 이번 주 토요일 */ TO_CHAR(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'IW') + 6, 'YYYY-MM-DD') /* 이번 주 일요일 */ )
AND s.class_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND s.remaining_people > 0 )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SCHEDULE s JOIN CLASS_REPEAT_RULE r ON s.REPEAT_RULE_CODE = r.REPEAT_RULE_CODE WHERE r.CLASS_CODE = c.CLASS_CODE AND s.MAX_PEOPLE >= #{minPeople} )
ORDER BY c.STAR_RATING_AVG DESC NULLS LAST, c.CLASS_CODE DESC
ORDER BY c.PRICE ASC
ORDER BY c.PRICE DESC
ORDER BY c.CLASS_CODE DESC
SELECT CLASS_IMG_CODE as classImgCode, CLASS_CODE as classCode, TYPE as type, IMAGE as image, SORT_ORDER as sortOrder FROM CLASS_IMAGE WHERE CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC
